parameters.content:
# START HERE: XB Kit Re-tagger (#269)

- **When:** daily 03:00 SGT (workflow timezone Asia/Singapore), or by hand with Manual Run.
- **Scope:** every ACTIVE product on the XB Shopify store. Only product tags change: the 30 kit tags `kit-<kit>` (8) and `ks-<slot>` (22) from the XT kit rules v1. `kit-no`, `kit-pin-<kit>`, unknown `kit-`/`ks-` tags and every other tag are never touched.
- **Flow:** settings -> one access token -> read all active products (100 per page) -> work out the tag changes -> dry run report, cap check or tag writes -> one email through **XB Ops Alert Email** (system `KIT-RETAG`).
- **Safe by default:** `DRY_RUN` is on: it reads and emails the list but writes nothing. A real run stops before any write when more than `CHANGE_CAP` (25) products would change or more than `REMOVE_CAP` (10) would lose a kit tag (one WARN email). `CAP_OVERRIDE` is the owner's one-run switch.
- **Emails:** dry run report and real changes (`[XB daily] KIT-RETAG DRYRUN|CHANGED <date>`), over-cap WARN and failures ERROR (`[XB alert] KIT-RETAG ...`). Nothing on a day with no change.
- **Failures:** a failed token, read, throttle or incomplete read writes nothing and sends one ERROR. Failed writes are listed by product handle; tag writes are safe to repeat, so the next run repairs them.
- **No saved executions** (the access token is in item data). Recovery: deactivate, run by hand with `DRY_RUN` on, read the list.
- Rules change only by a reviewed repo PR (`tests/fixtures/xb_kit_rules_v1.fixture`), never fetched at run time. Runbook: `docs/xb_kit_retagger.md`.

# Setup (local import copy only)

- Import inactive. **XB Ops Alert Email** must already accept system `KIT-RETAG` (re-imported first).
- Bind the Shopify app credential on **Get Shopify Access Token** only (type and fields: runbook). No other node has a credential.
- First real run, activation and any cap override each need their own owner OK.

## Required manual configuration:

- **Run Settings**
  - `SHOP_DOMAIN`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN` with the store's myshopify domain (in the local import copy, never in the repo).
  - `DRY_RUN`: leave `true` until the owner OKs a real run.
- **Send Kit Alert**
  - `Workflow`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_OPS_ALERT_EMAIL_WORKFLOW_ID` with the live XB Ops Alert Email workflow id.

# Read

- One token per run (client credentials grant, valid 24 h), retried up to 3 times.
- Active products, 100 per page, 1 s apart, at most 40 pages, plus Shopify's exact count of active products.
- A failed or throttled page stops the run in the next step: no writes.

# Decide

- The kit rules are pasted in **Work Out Kit Tag Changes** (logic fields only).
- Mode: failed, dry_run, no_change (quiet), over_cap (WARN, no writes) or write.
- An unexpected Code error sends one ERROR (Build Unexpected Alert).

# Write

- One GraphQL request per changed product, 1 every 500 ms: `tagsAdd` and/or `tagsRemove` only.
- Retried up to 3 times (safe to repeat). Any HTTP error, GraphQL error or userErrors is a failed write.
- Check Write Results sends the CHANGED report or one write_failed ERROR.

parameters.jsonBody: {"query": "query KitProducts($after: String) { productsCount(query: \"status:active\") { count precision } products(first: 100, after: $after, query: \"status:active\", sortKey: ID) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id handle title vendor productType status tags } } }", "variables": {"after": null}}

assignments.name: alert
assignments.value: ={{ ({ severity: 'ERROR', key: 'unexpected', short: 'unexpected', lines: ['Kit re-tagger: an unexpected error stopped the run (no saved execution to read).', 'Some tag writes may have gone through; the next daily run repairs kit tags.', 'Next: open n8n and run XB Kit Re-tagger by hand with DRY_RUN on, then read the list.'] }) }}
